name: Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls
description: On the Zambezi River, along the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe, Victoria Falls is one of the largest waterfalls on Earth. The river, nearly 1.7 km wide, drops into a series of basalt gorges with a roar. Its spray rises as a mist visible from over 20 km away, which is why local Lozi people call it Mosi-oa-Tunya, "Thundering Smoke.
